summary: Sends MIDI events to devices, software synths, or files when properly named input CHOP channels change.
key_concepts: Sends MIDI events to devices, software synths, or MIDI files whenever appropriately named input channels change.
Channel names map to MIDI events, such as ch3c14 for controller 14 on channel 3 or ch7n60 for note 60 on channel 7.
Time-sliced input preserves event timing when the TouchDesigner timeline is running in realtime.
Note and controller normalization determines whether input values are interpreted as raw 0-127 data or scaled from normalized ranges.
Cook Every Frame should be enabled for reliable output even when the CHOP is not displayed in a viewer.
The operator can send notes, aftertouch, pressure, pitch wheel, controller, program change, MIDI clock, start/stop/continue, and MIDI Timecode events.

key_params.name: prefix
key_params.note: Channel prefix used for event mapping

key_params.name: barticks
key_params.note: Ticks per bar for bar messages

common_gotchas: Input channels must be named according to MIDI event conventions such as ch3c14 or ch7n60.
Events are sent when channel values change during the last time slice; stable values do not resend unless behavior is forced elsewhere.
Realtime timing is preserved only when the TouchDesigner timeline is running in realtime.
If Normalize is None, note/control values must already be in MIDI 0-127 range; normalized mode maps 0-1 to 0-127.
Use Rename CHOP before MIDI Out CHOP when generated channel names do not match MIDI event naming rules.
The midioutCHOP Python class can send more flexible MIDI events through an existing MIDI Out CHOP.
